name: HYDRA-UMC-WATCH
build: ./build.sh or build.bat (bumps version, runs JUnit tests, assembleDebug). Wear OS 3+ target.
notes: Functional v0: differentiated haptic vibration patterns wired to Wear OS Vibrator, explicit microphone/system-STT capture and local TTS confirmation, plus typed voice_turn/assistant_reply/system_status messages. A paired Android Data Layer relay is implemented; it keeps the Server JWT on the phone and Voice UI token on CM5. Physical radio, wireless E-STOP and live CM5 telemetry remain hardware integration gates. Voice never directly actuates a robot.
